name: Marine Spatial Planning - SAHAV
description: MSP-SAHAV is an open software used for planning sea spaces that can help visualize and communicate complex spatial information, supporting informed decision-making and the process of organizing and managing human activities in marine areas across space and time.

name: ODK
description: ODK lets you build powerful forms to collect the data you need wherever it is. Join the leading researchers, field teams, and other professionals using ODK to collect data that matters.

name: Rural Environmental Registry Registration Module
description: The Rural Environmental Registry (RER) is a solution for managing declared geospatial environmental information on rural properties to serve as a database for control, monitoring, environmental and economic planning.
